Bisher erhaltene Abrechnungen der Leistungserbringer und/oder deren Dienstleistern, die in Papierform eingehen, sollen durch den Auftragnehmer digitalisiert und so der Auftraggeberin zur Verfügung gestellt werden. Dadurch erleichtert sich für die Auftraggeberin die Rechnungs- bearbeitung und es wird Potenzial für Prozessoptimierungen und -automatisierungen geschaf- fen. Details sind der Leistungsbeschreibung zu entnehmen. 1.1 Losbildung Eine Losbildung unterbleibt, da ein ganzheitlicher Scandienst mit der Gesamtverantwortung des künftigen Auftragnehmers ausgeschrieben wird. Ausgeschrieben wird ein Rahmenvertrag mit einem Wirtschaftsteilnehmer. Bieter sind aufgefordert, ein Angebot einzureichen. 1.2 Art der Vergabe Die Auftraggeberin schreibt die benötigten Leistungen in einem offenen Verfahren im Sinne von § 15 VgV aus. Dieses Vergabeverfahren wird aus Gründen der Transparenz über eine elektronische Vergabeplattform betrieben. Die Auftraggeberin verwendet ausschließ lich die Vergabeplattform der DTVP Deutsches Vergabeportal GmbH (www.dtvp.de). Es ist das zum Zeitpunkt der Veröffentlichung der Bekanntmachung geltende Vergaberecht maßgeblich, auch, wenn dieses sich während des Vergabeverfahrens ändern sollte. Täitja kohustub oma kulul esindama tellijat lepingu alusel täidetavate ülesannete või toimingutega seotud kõigis vaidlustes (sh kohtuvaidlustes) kolmandate isikutega ning kandma kõik sellega kaasnevad menetluskulud. 7.7 Tellija võib lepingu üles öelda, kui Täitja rikub oluliselt õigusaktidest või lepingust tulenevaid kohustusi. C.2 BACKGROUND NLS administers a free program that loans audio and braille books and magazines, music scores in braille and large print, and specially designed audio-playback and refreshable-braille-display equipment to residents of the United States who are unable to read or use standard print materials due to visual or physical impairment. NLS administers the program nationally, while direct service to eligible individuals and institutions is the responsibility of cooperating network libraries in the various states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Guam, and the U. S. Virgin Islands. This service is also extended to eligible American citizens residing abroad. C.3 SCOPE The contractor shall provide the Library with new perpetual RealSAM Dialog licenses and technical support for perpetual RealSAM Dialog licenses—new or legacy— in its possession. This support includes the services needed to operate and maintain NLS’s My Talking Books (an Amazon Alexa skill) in production. My Talking Books is an Amazon Alexa skill that enables NLS patrons to search the NLS collection, browse the NLS collection, retrieve/manage the patron’s Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) Wishlist, stream NLS talking books, and manage the patron’s Bookshelf using a voice-only interface available on Alexa-enabled commercial smart-speaker platforms. The contractor shall be responsible for providing RealSAM Dialog licenses and services required to operate the system in production, while meeting all IT information-system security requirements as required by the Library of Congress. C.2 BACKGROUND NLS administers a free program that loans audio and braille books and magazines, music scores in braille and large print, and specially designed audio-playback and refreshable-braille-display equipment to residents of the United States who are unable to read or use standard print materials due to visual or physical impairment. NLS administers the program nationally, while direct service to eligible individuals and institutions is the responsibility of cooperating network libraries in the various states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Guam, and the U. S. Virgin Islands. Thi

The contractor shall provide the Library with a price schedule (Attachment J3 - Pricing Chart.xlsx) for the following scenarios: A. RealSAM Dialog License Support – An annual fee for blocks of 500 perpetual user licenses for the RealSAM dialog engine. Highest-level owner means the entity that owns or controls an immediate owner of the offeror, or that owns or controls one or more entities that control an immediate owner of the offeror. No entity owns or exercises control of the highest level owner. Immediate owner means an entity, other than the offeror, that has direct control of the offeror. Indicators of control include, but are not limited to, one or more of the following: ownership or interlocking management, identity of interests among family members, shared facilities and equipment, and the common use of employees. Inverted domestic corporation, means a foreign incorporated entity that meets the definition of an inverted domestic corporation under 6 U.S.C. 395(b), applied in accordance with the rules and definitions of 6 U.S.C. 395(c). Small business concern— (1) Means a concern, including its affiliates, that is independently owned and operated, not dominant in its field of operation, and qualified as a small business under the criteria in 13 CFR part 121 and size standards in this solicitation. (2) Affiliates, as used in this definition, means business concerns, one of whom directly or indirectly controls or has the power to control the others, or a third party or parties control or have the power to control the others. BACKGROUND The Department of the Air Force Art Collection is comprised of over 9,000 paintings, works on paper, mixed media, textiles, and sculptures spanning from World War I to the present day. To ensure the long-term preservation and security of a specific portion of this historic collection, the NMUSAF requires temporary, climate- controlled on-site storage for 992 designated artworks at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base (WPAFB). Due to inadequate historical storage conditions at their previous location, all 992 of these specific artworks have experienced prior mold damage. To mitigate risk and contain the issue, all assets will be securely wrapped and packaged in protective materials prior to being placed into the storage containers, preventing any further spread of mold. Maintaining strict, continuous environmental controls within the storage containers is critical to arrest any active mold growth and protect the collection from further deterioration. 2.
